# CellShard atom, evidence, discovery, composition, grammar, basis, superatom, and partial Todo plan

This document contains the biology-heavy compiler work. Generic storage and runtime are intentionally excluded here so the atom vocabulary cannot disappear beneath systems machinery. Proposal providers remain nonauthoritative; certification is independent; composition has typed exact semantics; a flat explicit grammar and no-basis fallback remain complete even when experiments fail.

# Workstream CSBOOT: CellShard baseline, successor charter, and compatibility map

**Repository:** CellShard  
**Suggested lane:** `CS-JBC-L-BOOTSTRAP`  
**Barrier:** `JBC-G0-LIVE-BASELINE`

## Workstream design

Revalidate the nested repository and Todo authority, classify all live source, record the closed access-adapter anomaly without reopening it, and reserve additive compiler/runtime v2 paths. No behavior changes occur in baseline tasks.

- AGENTS.md

## Proposed Todos (6)

## CS-JBC-B01 — Revalidate nested CellShard and Todo authority

**Repository / subsystem / lane:** CellShard · `program/bootstrap` · `CS-JBC-L-BOOTSTRAP`  
**Classification:** validation/evidence  
**Parallelism:** Serial within CS-JBC-L-BOOTSTRAP; parallel with other provider/workstream lanes after JBC-G0-LIVE-BASELINE.

### Why

**Purpose.** Revalidate nested CellShard and Todo authority. Deliver this as one isolated, reviewable step in the CellShard baseline, successor charter, and compatibility map workstream.

**Biological motivation.** CellShard must be rechartered around compilation of biological recurrence rather than predefined row shards or a CSH5-to-CSPACK staging pipeline.

**Compiler-architectural reason.** The successor charter supersedes the bounded CS-FOUND non-goals without rewriting their historical meaning and records which legacy surfaces remain compatibility-only.

### Scope

**Likely write scope** — paths marked `[proposed]` do not yet exist:

- [proposed] docs/JBC/
- [proposed] planning/jbc/
- AGENTS.md
- docs/FORMAT_ROLES.md

**Existing code and permitted read scope:**

- AGENTS.md
- CMakeLists.txt
- docs/CS_FOUND_TRANSITION_MAP.md
- docs/FORMAT_ROLES.md
- docs/SPEC_CSPACK_V1.md
- include/CellShard/
- src/
- tests/

**Explicitly out of scope / forbidden shortcuts:**

- Do not regenerate CellShard Todo identity.
- Do not reopen or duplicate cellshard-cpp-access-adapter-refactor.
- Do not delete CSH5/CSPACK or sharded<T> during bootstrap.
- Do not reinterpret a statistical cluster as a causal biological module.
- Do not hide allocation, canonicalization, packing, assembly, transfer, or synchronization.
- Do not encode V100 tile dimensions, GPU ordinals, topology routes, or runtime pointers in portable biological identity.
- Do not mutate frozen CSG1, CPE2, CPK1, CSPACK, or CSH5 wire semantics without an adjacent version and compatibility route.
- Do not move Cellerator mathematical semantics into CellShard or CellShard global placement/storage semantics into standalone Cellerator.

### Inputs and dependencies

- None.

Expected inputs:

- The frozen shared atom/coverage/identity contracts applicable to this workstream.
- Exact live source identities revalidated before implementation.
- Caller-owned capacities, cost/reuse policy, and biological-stratum metadata where relevant.

### Outputs

- Focused tests and adversarial fixtures demonstrating both success and explicit rejection paths.

### Concrete mechanism

Record nested submodule commit, cleanliness, Git common identity, Todo UUID/revision/fingerprint, active run, stale sessions, frozen CS-FOUND interfaces, and the parent submodule pointer without mutating either authority.

Workstream mechanism: Revalidate the nested repository and Todo authority, classify all live source, record the closed access-adapter anomaly without reopening it, and reserve additive compiler/runtime v2 paths. No behavior changes occur in baseline tasks.

### Data flow, ownership, and complexity

- Cold builders may own explicit temporary storage; public execution views remain non-owning pointer-plus-count records.
- Semantic identity and exact coverage are inputs or validated outputs; storage location and runtime pointers remain operational state.
- Central registries, umbrella headers, package exports, and root CMake are changed only by the designated integration task.

- Document asymptotic and peak-memory behavior.
- Reject unbounded all-pairs or unrestricted subgraph enumeration unless this Todo is an exact small-instance oracle.
- Use streaming, bounded top-L structures, sketches, sparse maps, count/scan/fill, radix/sort, or caller-owned marks as appropriate.

**Cold versus hot path.** The named mechanism is cold compilation unless explicitly described as runtime. Any steady-state path must perform no discovery, catalog parsing, hidden allocation, global sorting, or topology search.

### Invariants

- Canonical biological identity is explicit and recoverable; shape, ordinal position, or equal extent never establishes equivalence.
- Approximate evidence may propose work, but only independently certified exact coverage may enter execution.
- Proposal overlap, physical-representation overlap, and execution-contribution overlap remain distinct.
- Each logical contribution has one exact owner unless a versioned partial-result algebra proves reconstruction.
- Structure, mutable values, transient state, runtime residency, and preference/cost freshness have separate generations and invalidation.

### Failure cases and fallback

- Malformed or stale identity/generation data must be rejected before execution.
- Weak or unstable biological structure must produce a valid no-candidate or no-promotion outcome.
- Capacity overflow, duplicate identity, incomplete coverage, and candidate explosion must return explicit diagnostics.

### Validation

- Record exact Project Control cursor, submodule commit, and standalone/embedded build commands.
- Add deterministic unit tests, malformed-input tests, and randomized property tests.
- Where an approximate proposal is used, compare it with an exact rescan and independently validate the certified output.
- Keep at least one canonical/reference fallback and differential-test against it.

### Performance evidence and promotion

- Record cold build time, peak memory, candidate count, and work avoided or added.
- Do not promote from microkernel speed alone; report complete cost and reuse break-even.
- A measured non-promotion is an acceptable terminal result for experimental mechanisms.

### Integration and completion

**Integration point.** Source-linked fragment or frozen interface owned by lane CS-JBC-L-BOOTSTRAP; final aggregation is integration-lane-only.

**Downstream consumers:**

- None.

**Completion condition.** The contract/implementation is source-complete, independently validated, profiler-visible, and consumable through fixtures without central-file edits.

# Workstream CSSS: Support-signature atom discovery

**Repository:** CellShard  
**Suggested lane:** `CS-JBC-L-DISC-SIGNATURE`  
**Barrier:** `JBC-G2-EVIDENCE-CERTIFICATION`

## Workstream design

Stream sorted unique destination supports, form exact signatures and fixed-seed MinHash sketches, use bounded deterministic LSH buckets to propose pairs/groups, deduplicate and cap candidates, then compute exact Jaccard/containment/shared/residual support in a canonical rescan. Persist sketches and negative evidence.

- Cellerator support_relation_view_v1
- CellShard evidence atlas
- CellShard atom certification

- [proposed] tests/jbc/discovery/support_signature/

# Workstream CSBC: Biclustering and co-clustering atom discovery

**Repository:** CellShard  
**Suggested lane:** `CS-JBC-L-DISC-BICLUSTER`  
**Barrier:** `JBC-G2-EVIDENCE-CERTIFICATION`

## Workstream design

Baseline: seed from high-affinity pairs/rectangles; alternately add sources and destinations whose exact marginal gain is positive under useful support, padding, residual fragmentation, cross-operation reuse, stability, and materialization cost; stop at bounds; exact-census and certify finalists. Add a spectral co-clustering provider only as a measured alternative.

- CellShard evidence atlas
- Cellerator rectangular_support
- CellShard certification

- [proposed] include/CellShard/compiler/discovery/bicluster/
- [proposed] src/compiler/discovery/bicluster/
- [proposed] tests/jbc/discovery/bicluster/
- [proposed] bench/jbc/bicluster/

# Workstream CSOC: Bounded overlapping-community atom discovery

**Repository:** CellShard  
**Suggested lane:** `CS-JBC-L-DISC-OVERLAP`

# Workstream CSMF: Typed motif and frequent-fragment atom discovery

**Repository:** CellShard  
**Suggested lane:** `CS-JBC-L-DISC-MOTIF`  
**Barrier:** `JBC-G2-EVIDENCE-CERTIFICATION`

## Workstream design

Begin with a bounded source-linked motif template library. Canonicalize typed directed motifs deterministically, enumerate occurrences with strict node/edge/per-anchor caps, count recurrence by relation, stratum, and graph family, convert accepted occurrences to exact candidates, and preserve a frequent-fragment miner as an experimental alternative.

- CellShard certification

- [proposed] tests/jbc/discovery/motif/

**Repository:** CellShard

# Workstream CSMM: Multimodal identity-spine and atom discovery

**Repository:** CellShard  
**Suggested lane:** `CS-JBC-L-DISC-MULTIMODAL`  
**Barrier:** `JBC-G2-EVIDENCE-CERTIFICATION`

## Workstream design

Build a stable identity-spine table with per-modality local ID or missing sentinel, retain modality-specific overlays, represent unmatched entities explicitly, consume typed cross-modal relations, propose shared-destination/order bundles, and certify every mapping. Equal dimensions never imply identity.

## Existing live source extended

- CellShard domain descriptors

# Workstream CSBASIS: Biological execution basis selection

**Repository:** CellShard  
**Suggested lane:** `CS-JBC-L-BASIS`  
**Barrier:** `JBC-G2-EVIDENCE-CERTIFICATION`

## Workstream design

Required baseline: deterministic greedy marginal benefit beginning from the no-basis canonical path, recomputing overlap-aware benefit after each selection and stopping at no positive gain. Add add/remove/swap/split/merge refinement, exact small-instance oracle, weighted set-cover and facility-location alternatives, multiple workload-family bases, redundant membership, persistence/freshness, and Pareto output.

- certified atoms
- composition grammar
- workload-family profiles
- Cellerator candidate costs

- [proposed] include/CellShard/compiler/basis/
- [proposed] src/compiler/basis/

- [proposed] bench/jbc/basis/

**Parallelism:** Serial within CS-JBC-L-BASIS; parallel with other provider/workstream lanes after JBC-G2-EVIDENCE-CERTIFICATION.

### Why

**Purpose.** Implement one-for-one and one-for-many swaps. Deliver this as one isolated, reviewable step in the Biological execution basis selection workstream.

**Biological motivation.** A basis selects reusable biological execution atoms from which several likely operation graphs can be assembled without repeatedly reshaping canonical data.

**Compiler-architectural reason.** Basis selection is not caching or byte chunking: it jointly prices graph coverage, assembly, storage, mutation, persistent order, cross-operation reuse, and cross-plan reuse.

### Scope

**Likely write scope** — paths marked `[proposed]` do not yet exist:

- [proposed] include/CellShard/compiler/basis/
- [proposed] src/compiler/basis/
- [proposed] tests/jbc/basis/
- [proposed] bench/jbc/basis/

**Existing code and permitted read scope:**

- certified atoms
- composition grammar
- workload-family profiles
- Cellerator candidate costs

**Explicitly out of scope / forbidden shortcuts:**

- Do not force a basis where no positive expected benefit exists.
- Do not confuse workload requirement coverage with biological entity coverage.
- Do not reinterpret a statistical cluster as a causal biological module.
- Do not hide allocation, canonicalization, packing, assembly, transfer, or synchronization.
- Do not encode V100 tile dimensions, GPU ordinals, topology routes, or runtime pointers in portable biological identity.
- Do not mutate frozen CSG1, CPE2, CPK1, CSPACK, or CSH5 wire semantics without an adjacent version and compatibility route.
- Do not move Cellerator mathematical semantics into CellShard or CellShard global placement/storage semantics into standalone Cellerator.

### Inputs and dependencies

- CS-JBC-BS08

Expected inputs:

- The frozen shared atom/coverage/identity contracts applicable to this workstream.
- Exact live source identities revalidated before implementation.
- Caller-owned capacities, cost/reuse policy, and biological-stratum metadata where relevant.

### Outputs

- A source implementation that consumes explicit caller-owned storage or declares its allocations and produces deterministic diagnostics.

### Concrete mechanism

Replace selected atoms with alternative candidates or compositions when total expected cost improves under deterministic bounded search.

Workstream mechanism: Required baseline: deterministic greedy marginal benefit beginning from the no-basis canonical path, recomputing overlap-aware benefit after each selection and stopping at no positive gain. Add add/remove/swap/split/merge refinement, exact small-instance oracle, weighted set-cover and facility-location alternatives, multiple workload-family bases, redundant membership, persistence/freshness, and Pareto output.

### Data flow, ownership, and complexity

- Cold builders may own explicit temporary storage; public execution views remain non-owning pointer-plus-count records.
- Semantic identity and exact coverage are inputs or validated outputs; storage location and runtime pointers remain operational state.
- Central registries, umbrella headers, package exports, and root CMake are changed only by the designated integration task.

- Document asymptotic and peak-memory behavior.
- Reject unbounded all-pairs or unrestricted subgraph enumeration unless this Todo is an exact small-instance oracle.
- Use streaming, bounded top-L structures, sketches, sparse maps, count/scan/fill, radix/sort, or caller-owned marks as appropriate.

**Cold versus hot path.** The named mechanism is cold compilation unless explicitly described as runtime. Any steady-state path must perform no discovery, catalog parsing, hidden allocation, global sorting, or topology search.

### Invariants

- Canonical biological identity is explicit and recoverable; shape, ordinal position, or equal extent never establishes equivalence.
- Approximate evidence may propose work, but only independently certified exact coverage may enter execution.
- Proposal overlap, physical-representation overlap, and execution-contribution overlap remain distinct.
- Each logical contribution has one exact owner unless a versioned partial-result algebra proves reconstruction.
- Structure, mutable values, transient state, runtime residency, and preference/cost freshness have separate generations and invalidation.

### Failure cases and fallback

- Malformed or stale identity/generation data must be rejected before execution.
- Weak or unstable biological structure must produce a valid no-candidate or no-promotion outcome.
- Capacity overflow, duplicate identity, incomplete coverage, and candidate explosion must return explicit diagnostics.

### Validation

- Use planted optimal bases, disjoint and overlapping utility, mutation-heavy workloads, and exact oracle comparisons.
- Add deterministic unit tests, malformed-input tests, and randomized property tests.
- Where an approximate proposal is used, compare it with an exact rescan and independently validate the certified output.
- Keep at least one canonical/reference fallback and differential-test against it.

### Performance evidence and promotion

- Record cold build time, peak memory, candidate count, and work avoided or added.
- Do not promote from microkernel speed alone; report complete cost and reuse break-even.
- A measured non-promotion is an acceptable terminal result for experimental mechanisms.

### Integration and completion

**Integration point.** Source-linked fragment or frozen interface owned by lane CS-JBC-L-BASIS; final aggregation is integration-lane-only.

**Downstream consumers:**

- None.

**Completion condition.** The contract/implementation is source-complete, independently validated, profiler-visible, and consumable through fixtures without central-file edits.

## CS-JBC-PP18 — Evaluate partial profitability and promotion

**Repository / subsystem / lane:** CellShard · `compiler/partial` · `CS-JBC-L-PARTIALS`  
**Classification:** settled required mechanism  
**Parallelism:** Serial within CS-JBC-L-PARTIALS; parallel with other provider/workstream lanes after JBC-G2-EVIDENCE-CERTIFICATION.

### Why

**Purpose.** Evaluate partial profitability and promotion. Deliver this as one isolated, reviewable step in the Persistent partial computation atoms workstream.

**Biological motivation.** Biological computations repeatedly reuse structural transforms, segment summaries, moments, branch prefixes, gathered panels, and mergeable states; persisting only completed tensors misses this recurrence.

**Compiler-architectural reason.** A persistent partial is a versioned atom with exact dependencies, algebra, numerical policy, generation, and profitability—not an opaque cached intermediate.

### Scope

**Likely write scope** — paths marked `[proposed]` do not yet exist:

- [proposed] include/CellShard/compiler/partial/
- [proposed] src/compiler/partial/
- [proposed] tests/jbc/partial/
- [proposed] bench/jbc/partial/

**Existing code and permitted read scope:**

- Cellerator partial-result algebra
- CellShard atom planes
- CellShard composition
- Cellerator atom-emitting outputs

**Explicitly out of scope / forbidden shortcuts:**

- Do not persist an intermediate whose model/scientific validity is unknown.
- Do not reuse a partial across value or parameter generations unless the dependency contract proves validity.
- Do not reinterpret a statistical cluster as a causal biological module.
- Do not hide allocation, canonicalization, packing, assembly, transfer, or synchronization.
- Do not encode V100 tile dimensions, GPU ordinals, topology routes, or runtime pointers in portable biological identity.
- Do not mutate frozen CSG1, CPE2, CPK1, CSPACK, or CSH5 wire semantics without an adjacent version and compatibility route.
- Do not move Cellerator mathematical semantics into CellShard or CellShard global placement/storage semantics into standalone Cellerator.

- CS-JBC-PP17

### Concrete mechanism

Compare persist/reuse with recomputation across mutation and reuse horizons; record storage, merge, finalization, invalidation, and numerical cost; nonpromotion is valid.

Workstream mechanism: Provide atom species for structural and transform partials, additive/extremum/log-sum-exp/moments states, segment summaries, relation contributions, gathered panels, static prefixes, trajectory prefixes, parameterized functions, and legal gradients. For each class define neutral/merge/finalize, dependency closure, serialization, validator, and complete-cost promotion.

### Data flow, ownership, and complexity

- Cold builders may own explicit temporary storage; public execution views remain non-owning pointer-plus-count records.
- Semantic identity and exact coverage are inputs or validated outputs; storage location and runtime pointers remain operational state.
- Central registries, umbrella headers, package exports, and root CMake are changed only by the designated integration task.

- Document asymptotic and peak-memory behavior.
- Reject unbounded all-pairs or unrestricted subgraph enumeration unless this Todo is an exact small-instance oracle.
- Use streaming, bounded top-L structures, sketches, sparse maps, count/scan/fill, radix/sort, or caller-owned marks as appropriate.

**Cold versus hot path.** The named mechanism is cold compilation unless explicitly described as runtime. Any steady-state path must perform no discovery, catalog parsing, hidden allocation, global sorting, or topology search.

### Invariants

- Canonical biological identity is explicit and recoverable; shape, ordinal position, or equal extent never establishes equivalence.
- Approximate evidence may propose work, but only independently certified exact coverage may enter execution.
- Proposal overlap, physical-representation overlap, and execution-contribution overlap remain distinct.
- Each logical contribution has one exact owner unless a versioned partial-result algebra proves reconstruction.
- Structure, mutable values, transient state, runtime residency, and preference/cost freshness have separate generations and invalidation.

### Failure cases and fallback

- Malformed or stale identity/generation data must be rejected before execution.
- Weak or unstable biological structure must produce a valid no-candidate or no-promotion outcome.
- Capacity overflow, duplicate identity, incomplete coverage, and candidate explosion must return explicit diagnostics.

### Validation

- Add deterministic unit tests, malformed-input tests, and randomized property tests.
- Where an approximate proposal is used, compare it with an exact rescan and independently validate the certified output.
- Keep at least one canonical/reference fallback and differential-test against it.
